headline: Amazon downgrades Apple Wallet order tracking feature for shoppers
summary: Amazon's recent change significantly reduces the functionality of Apple Wallet's order tracking for its customers. This means less detailed and less timely updates directly within the Wallet app.
details: Amazon has implemented a change that significantly downgrades the order tracking feature within Apple Wallet for its customers. This alteration means users will no longer receive detailed, real-time updates directly through the Wallet app.

Previously, Apple Wallet provided comprehensive tracking information for Amazon orders, including shipping status, delivery estimates, and even specific package locations. This integration offered a seamless and convenient experience for many users.

The new change limits the information available, making the Wallet feature less useful for monitoring Amazon purchases. Users will now likely need to rely on Amazon's own app or website for full tracking details.

This move by Amazon impacts a popular feature that enhanced the user experience for those who frequently shop on the platform and use Apple's ecosystem. The exact reasons for Amazon's decision have not been explicitly stated.
